rows.corpus_definition: To end a phone conversation by putting the receiver down.
rows.example_en: He did not say goodbye before he hung up.

rows.corpus_definition: a very strong feeling of dislike for someone
rows.example_en: There is no place for hatred in this world.

rows.corpus_definition: a very strong feeling of dislike or anger toward someone
rows.example_en: His hatred of injustice drove him to become a lawyer.

rows.corpus_definition: to be wearing a piece of clothing.
rows.example_en: She had a red hat on today.

rows.corpus_definition: The main title of a news story.
rows.example_en: I read the headline in the newspaper.

rows.corpus_definition: The back rounded part of the bottom of a foot.
rows.example_en: Her heel was sore from wearing those uncomfortable shoes.

rows.corpus_definition: To pause before doing something because you are not sure.
rows.example_en: Do not hesitate to call if you need help.

rows.corpus_definition: to pause because you are not sure what to do or say
rows.example_en: She hesitated before answering the difficult question.

rows.corpus_definition: A small piece of information that helps you guess something.
rows.example_en: She gave me a hint about my surprise party.

rows.corpus_definition: The quality of always speaking the truth to other people.
rows.example_en: Honesty is the most important part of our friendship.

rows.corpus_definition: not thinking you are better or more important than others
rows.example_en: Despite his fame, the actor remained humble and kind.

rows.corpus_definition: not allowed by the laws of a place.
rows.example_en: It is illegal to drive without a license.
